title: tabernaemontana crispa

It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the alleviation of pain, anxiety, and stress, as well as its ability to enhance focus and productivity. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana crispa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids such as mitragynine and 7-hydroxymitragynine, that interact with opioid receptors in the brain to produce a unique set of effects. The bioactive constituents of Tabernaemontana crispa have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications, including their analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antidepressant properties.
